source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of positron emission tomography (PDF 164-165).

blocks.text: Ionising shuaein use karne wale imaging tareeqe is par munhasir hain ke shua maddah se kaise amal karti hai: tissue se guzarte photons jazb ya bikhar sakte hain, aur jama aur kam hoti tawanai ka naqsha detector par qabil-e-paimaish signals banata hai. Nuclear medicine mein shua mareez ke andar se, diye gaye radiopharmaceutical se, shuru hoti hai, is liye signal jism ki shakal (anatomy) ke bajaye us ka kaam (function) dikhata hai. Single photon emission computed tomography (SPECT) mein gamma chhorne wala tracer jism mein dala jata aur ghoomta gamma camera bohat se manazir record karta hai, jinhein tracer ki taqseem ki cross-sectional tasaveer mein dobara banaya jata hai, jo khoon ke bahao aur aza ke kaam ki 3D maloomat deti hain.

Positron emission tomography (PET) is khayal ko positron chhorne wale tracers se aage barhati hai (Fig 20.10 PET scanner dikhati hai). Radioactive tracer ki thori si miqdar nas mein injection se di jati hai; khoon use le jata hai, aur yeh bohat faal tissues, jaise bohat se cancers aur dimagh aur dil ke kaam karte hisson, mein zyada jama hota hai. Tracer ke ghair-mustahkam nuclei toot'te hue positrons chhorte hain. Har positron qareebi tissue ke electron se milne se pehle sirf thora faasla tay karta hai; dono khatam ho jate hain, aur un ki kamiyat do gamma-ray photons mein badal jati hai jo mukhalif simton mein chalte hain. Mareez ke gird detectors ki ring in photon joron ko coincidence mein (aik hi lamhe pohanchte) pakarti aur signals computer ko bhejti hai, jo har waqia do detectors ko jorne wali lakeer par rakh kar tasveer banata hai ke tracer kahan jama hua (Fig 20.11). Zyada roshan hisse tracer ka zyada concentration aur is liye tissue ki zyada sargarmi dikhate hain.

Yun PET ghair-dakhli tareeqa hai jo cell aur molecule ki satah par metabolic aur biochemical sargarmi ki tasveer banata hai, is liye yeh cancer ki jaldi pehchan aur marhala bandi, dimagh ke kaam ki jaanch, aur wazeh banawati tabdeeliyon se pehle dil ki kharabiyon ki pehchan ke liye bohat qeemti hai.
Cancer ke ilaj mein medical physics

Medical physics cancer ke ilaj aur tashkhees mein bhi bohat ahem hai, khaas taur par radiotherapy ke zariye, jo sehatmand tissue ko kam se kam nuqsan pohancha kar zyada tawanai ki shuaon se rasoli ke cells maarti hai. Shuaon se ilaj ke do bare tareeqe hain: teletherapy, jis mein shua jism ke bahar ki machine se di jati hai, aur brachytherapy, jis mein radioactive source rasoli ke andar ya qareeb rakha jata hai. Medical physicists oncology team ka hissa hain: yeh saaman ke mayaar ki yaqeen-dahani, ilaj ke waqt ka hisaab, ilaj ki mansooba bandi aur cancer wale hisse mein khurak ki taqseem ka naqsha banane ke mahir hain, aur har ilaj ko mehfooz aur mo'assar banane ke liye radiation oncologists, dosimetrists aur laboratory technicians ke saath kaam karte hain.

blocks.prompt: PET scanning mein coincidence detection ka kya kirdar hai?
blocks.explanation: Sirf woh gamma rays ke jore gine jate hain jo aik hi lamhe mukhalif detectors par pohanchein, is liye har waqia do detectors ko jorne wali lakeer par rakha ja sakta hai; is se annihilation ki jagah milti aur ghair-mutalliqa akele photons rad hote hain.

items: SPECT: gamma chhorne wala tracer aur ghoomta camera.
PET: tracer ka positron khatam; mukhalif simton mein 0.51 MeV ki do gamma rays coincidence mein pakri jati.
PET kaam dikhata: cancer, dimagh, dil; teletherapy ya brachytherapy se radiotherapy.
